title: Titanium Suspension Tie Rod
function: Race suspension double-ended adjustable tie rod
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this suspension application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by race suspension double-ended adjustable tie rod and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for suspension geometry
Shot peening Almen with 0.5mm corner radius
Black oxide/DLC coating with 0.5mm corner radius
CMM SPC dimensional check with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability
commonFailures: Fatigue crack at thread-shank transition - prevented by larger fillet R0.5->1.5mm + cold rolling

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Suspension Tie Rod suitable for Race suspension double-ended adjustable tie rod?
faq.a: Titanium Suspension Tie Rod uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address suspension operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Suspension Tie Rod?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Suspension Tie Rod require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. suspension components receive DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Suspension Tie Rod shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Tie rod / Track rod suspension components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
